name: @cortexkit/dsh-magic-context
description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin for Magic Context — cross-session memory and context management
author: ualtinok

scripts.build: bun ../../scripts/check-bun.mjs && bun ../../scripts/clean-dist-chunks.mjs dist index.js && bun ../../scripts/clean-dist-chunks.mjs dist index.js migration-worker.js auto-search-worker.js raw-ordinal-warmup-worker.js compaction-marker-candidates-worker.js chunk-embedding-write-worker.js embedding-worker.js embedding-worker-process.js && bun build src/index.ts ../plugin/src/features/magic-context/memory/embedding-worker.ts ../plugin/src/features/magic-context/memory/embedding-worker-process.ts ../plugin/src/features/magic-context/migration-worker.ts ../plugin/src/hooks/magic-context/auto-search-worker.ts ../plugin/src/hooks/magic-context/raw-ordinal-warmup-worker.ts ../plugin/src/features/magic-context/compaction-marker-candidates-worker.ts ../plugin/src/features/magic-context/chunk-embedding-write-worker.ts --outdir dist --entry-naming '[name].[ext]' --target node --format esm --splitting --external @deepseek-ai/cordis --external @deepseek-ai/dsh-session --external @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent --external @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm --external @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools --external @deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction --external @deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter --external @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-query --external @deepseek-ai/dsh-attachment --external @deepseek-ai/dsh-commands --external node:sqlite
scripts.test: bun ../../scripts/check-bun.mjs && bun install --frozen-lockfile && MC_SLOW_TESTS=0 bun test --parallel=4 --timeout 30000
